clarifications.en: Recognition is advanced by Crown icons on completed Orders or by paying at the Magistrate's Hall.
clarifications.zh: 声望经已完成委托上的御令或在州衙付费推进。

clarifications.en: Advancing at the Magistrate's Hall resolves the reward of the space you reach normally.
clarifications.zh: 在州衙推进声望，照常结算所到之格的奖励。

clarifications.en: Resolve 1 Crown at a time. Resolve every milestone crossed.
clarifications.zh: 御令逐个结算，所跨各格奖励皆结算。

clarifications.en: Each milestone reward is gained only once.
clarifications.zh: 每项声望奖励只得一次。

track.title: Imperial Gift
track.rewardText: Gain your Imperial Kiln tile: a private space fired by the court at the Kiln Die result + Fire + a modifier you choose when loading, immune to Contributions.
track.rewardTextZh: 获得你的御窑板块：一座私人单格窑，由御匠代烧，实际火候 = 窑骰点数 + 窑火修正 + 装窑时选定的御窑修正，不受控火影响。

clarifications.en: The Imperial Kiln holds 1 ceramic per firing. It does not occupy a Shared Kiln space.
clarifications.zh: 御窑每次烧成只容纳1件，不占共窑窑位。

clarifications.en: During a Glaze & Load action, 1 vessel loaded by that action may be placed in your empty Imperial Kiln instead of the Shared Kiln. Imperial Priority also loads it. No Tech effect loads it.
clarifications.zh: 施釉装窑行动中所装器物可有1件改放入你空置的御窑；御烧优先也可装入。技艺效果一律不能把器物装进御窑。

clarifications.en: Loading it chooses the −1, 0 or +1 Imperial modifier. The modifier is public when chosen and is recorded on the ceramic.
clarifications.zh: 装入时选定御窑修正−1、0或+1；选定即公开，并记录在该器物上。

clarifications.en: Its Actual Heat is the Kiln Die result + the Fire modifier + that modifier, plus any Heat marker, whatever the Contributions were. It still fires during the shared Firing Phase.
clarifications.zh: 其实际火候 = 窑骰点数 + 窑火修正 + 御窑修正 + 火标，不论控火如何；它仍在共同的烧窑阶段烧成。

clarifications.en: It counts as a ceramic in this firing for your Techs and abilities, but it does not make you a Contribution participant: only a ceramic in the Shared Kiln does.
clarifications.zh: 对你的技艺与窑口能力而言，它算作本次烧成中的器物；但不使你成为控火者，只有共窑中的器物才算。

clarifications.en: If only Imperial Kiln ceramics are loaded, Contributions are skipped and Base Heat is the Kiln Die result; the Fire card is still revealed.
clarifications.zh: 若只有御窑器物入窑，则无人控火，基础火候即窑骰点数；仍翻窑火牌。

clarifications.en: Kiln Furniture, Inverted Firing and Setter's Mark affect the Shared Kiln only.
clarifications.zh: 支烧窑具、覆烧、窑位签只作用于共窑。

clarifications.en: After firing, its ceramic resolves Quality and moves to the owner's Finished Ceramics area normally.
clarifications.zh: 烧成后照常定品，移入成器区。

clarifications.en: An Imperial Kiln gained during the before-or-after-action window is usable within it.
clarifications.zh: 在“工人行动之前或之后”时机中刚获得的御窑，即可于该时机使用。

clarifications.en: The Imperial Kiln is gained only once.
clarifications.zh: 御窑只得一次。

track.title: Imperial Priority
track.rewardText: Take your coloured Imperial Priority token. Once per game, before or after your worker action, spend it to give 1 of your Shaped vessels a Glaze and load it into your empty Imperial Kiln.
track.rewardTextZh: 从声望轨上取走你颜色的御烧优先标。每局一次，在你的工人行动之前或之后，交出此标，为你的1件坯施釉并装进你空着的御窑。

clarifications.en: Imperial Priority is free. Loading through it chooses the −1, 0 or +1 Imperial modifier like any Imperial load, and the modifier is public.
clarifications.zh: 御烧优先免费；经其装窑同样选定御窑修正−1、0或+1，且公开。

clarifications.en: Imperial Priority is a token effect, not a worker action. It never counts as a Glaze & Load action and does not trigger effects that require that action.
clarifications.zh: 御烧优先是令牌效果，不是工人行动；不算施釉装窑行动，也不触发需要该行动的效果。

clarifications.en: A later Glaze & Load Shifu may place the Heat marker on a ceramic loaded by Imperial Priority.
clarifications.zh: 之后施釉装窑行动的师傅可将火标暗置于经御烧优先装入的器物上。

clarifications.en: Canal Barge and Imperial Priority may share the window in an order you choose. A token gained during the window is usable within it.
clarifications.zh: 与漕船同在“工人行动之前或之后”时，二者先后由你自定；在此时机中刚获得的令牌即可使用。

clarifications.en: After a Commission Market action, the display refills after any after-action Imperial Priority.
clarifications.zh: 瓷牙行行动后，委托榜在行动后的御烧优先之后才补。

clarifications.en: Provisional ruling: Reworking Table may be used when Imperial Priority glazes and loads a vessel, using its once-per-round allowance.
clarifications.zh: 暂定裁定：御烧优先为坯施釉装窑时亦可用改坯案，并消耗其“每轮一次”。

clarifications.en: The Imperial Priority token is gained only once.
clarifications.zh: 御烧优先标只得一次。

track.title: Imperial Audience
track.rewardText: Gain 6 VP. After this, each further Crown scores 1 VP immediately.
track.rewardTextZh: 获得6分。此后每获得1个御令，立即得1分。

clarifications.en: The Magistrate's Hall cannot advance you to Recognition 4; only Crowns reach it.
clarifications.zh: 州衙不能推进到声望4，只有御令可达。

clarifications.en: Resolve Crowns one at a time. A multi-Crown Order may cross several milestones, reach Recognition 4 and then score VP from any remaining Crowns on that same Order.
clarifications.zh: 御令逐个结算；一张多御令委托可连跨数格，到达声望4后，同一委托余下的御令即各计1分。

clarifications.en: Tribute Ware's bonus Crown also advances Recognition.
clarifications.zh: 贡瓷的额外御令同样推进御府声望。

clarifications.en: Imperial Audience is gained only once.
clarifications.zh: 御前召见只得一次。

imperial_overflow.en: After you are at Recognition 4, each additional Crown you gain scores 1 VP immediately.
imperial_overflow.zh: 声望满4后，每获得1个御令，立即得1分。

imperial_overflow.en: A multi-Crown Order may reach Recognition 4 and then score VP from any remaining Crowns on that same Order.
imperial_overflow.zh: 一张多御令委托可先到达声望4，再以余下的御令计分。

imperial_overflow.en: Tribute Ware's bonus Crown scores past Recognition 4, but it is not a printed Crown and does not count for tie-breaker 2.
imperial_overflow.zh: 贡瓷的额外御令在声望满4后计1分，但不是印刷御令，不计入平局判定②。

imperial_overflow.en: Tie-breaker 2 counts Crown icons printed across completed Orders, including those scored beyond Recognition 4.
imperial_overflow.zh: 平局判定②计已完成委托上印有的御令总数，含声望满4后计分的御令。
